text:
Ava Ramos: Quick heads-up — final comms checklist for tomorrow's launch has one small timing change: embargo window moves from 09:00 PT to 09:30 PT. See doc: https://go.redwood/launch-comms-v3 (edit in COMMENTS only).

Jim Park: Noted. Is the press embargo shift because of the demo run?

Ava Ramos: Yep — final product demo is now at 08:20 PT and we need the extra buffer for short QA + a quick CEO quote.

Leah Chen: OK — I'll update the press brief and the inbound Q&A doc. Do we need to resend the embargo time to the top-tier outlets?

Ava Ramos: Yes — please resend to FT, TechCrunch, The Verge. Use the same subject line but append: "updated embargo time". Also @PressOps Bot, schedule a second reminder 30 mins before embargo lift.

PressOps Bot: scheduled reminder for 2026-05-14T09:00:00-07:00 (30m before 09:30 PT). :white_check_mark:

Owen Patel: Legal cleared the quote language. Leah — can you post the final PR-approved quote into the doc and tag Legal for visibility?

Leah Chen: Will do in 2 mins. Also adjusting the social plan: we'll shift the primary tweet at 09:35 PT and push the long-form LinkedIn to 09:45 PT. Snippet: `Tweet @09:35: "Introducing Redwood Optimize — inference, tuned for production."`

Jim Park: Can ops confirm the demo livestream link is public at 08:15 PT? Last time it defaulted to private.

Ava Ramos: Ops confirmed earlier. Link: https://redwood.live/launch. I'll double-check at 07:50 PT.

Leah Chen: Final checklist update: added two items — (1) embargo updated to 09:30 PT, (2) CEO quote final paragraph replaced per Legal. Comments only, no content edits without Legal.

Owen Patel: Thx. If any outlet pushes for earlier pickup, route to me and I'll escalate.

Jim Park: :thumbsup: thanks team — I'll be on standby for press follow-ups.

Ava Ramos: Great. Last call — if no objections by 17:00 PT today we push these changes live.

PressOps Bot: Reminder set for 17:00 PT to confirm final checklist status.
